```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r import}
library(readr)
hate_crimes <- read.csv("hate_crime_data.csv")

cargo_theft <- read.csv("cargo_theft_data.csv")

human_traffic <- read.csv("human_traffic_data.csv")

assaults_law <- read.csv("assault_law.csv")
```

```{r clean}
library(dplyr)
assaults_2015 <- assaults_law %>%
  mutate(DATA_YEAR = as.integer(DATA_YEAR))

assault_filtered <- assaults_2015 %>%
  filter(DATA_YEAR >= 2015)

head(assault_filtered)

cargo_theft_2015 <- cargo_theft %>%
  mutate(DATA_YEAR = as.integer(DATA_YEAR))

cargo_filtered <- cargo_theft_2015 %>%
  filter(DATA_YEAR >= 2015)

head(cargo_filtered)

hate_crimes_2015 <- hate_crimes %>%
  mutate(DATA_YEAR = as.integer(DATA_YEAR))

hate_crimes_filtered <- hate_crimes_2015 %>%
  filter(DATA_YEAR >= 2015)

head(hate_crimes_filtered)

human_traffic_2015 <- human_traffic %>%
  mutate(DATA_YEAR = as.integer(DATA_YEAR))

human_traffic_filtered <- human_traffic_2015 %>%
  filter(DATA_YEAR >= 2015)

head(human_traffic_filtered)

```

```{r plot}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

crimes_per_yr_human <- human_traffic_filtered %>%
  group_by(DATA_YEAR) %>%
  summarize(total_crimes_human = sum(ACTUAL_COUNT, na.rm = TRUE))

print(crimes_per_yr_human)

crimes_per_yr_hate <- hate_crimes_filtered %>%
  group_by(DATA_YEAR) %>%
  summarize(total_crimes_hate = sum(incident_id, na.rm = TRUE))

print(crimes_per_yr_hate)

crimes_per_yr_cargo <- cargo_filtered %>%
  group_by(DATA_YEAR) %>%
  summarize(total_crimes_cargo = n())

print(crimes_per_yr_cargo)


crimes_per_yr_assault <- assault_filtered %>%
  group_by(DATA_YEAR) %>%
  summarize(total_crimes_assault = n())

print(crimes_per_yr_assault)


crimes_human <- data.frame(data_year = 2015:2022, total_crimes_human = c(30, 35, 33, 38))
crimes_hate <- data.frame(data_year = 2015:2022, total_crimes_hate = c(5, 6, 7, 5))
crimes_cargo <- data.frame(data_year = 2015:2022, total_crimes_cargo = c(10, 12, 11, 14))
crimes_assault <- data.frame(data_year = 2015:2022, total_crimes_assault = c(20, 25, 22, 26))

# Combine datasets into one data frame
combined_data <- bind_rows(
  mutate(crimes_human, crime_type = "Human"),
  mutate(crimes_hate, crime_type = "Hate"),
  mutate(crimes_cargo, crime_type = "Cargo"),
  mutate(crimes_assault, crime_type = "Assault")
) 

# Reshape from wide to long format
long_data <- combined_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("total_crimes"),
               names_to = "crime_variable",
               values_to = "count") %>%
  select(-crime_variable)  # Remove the unnecessary variable

ggplot(long_data, aes(x = data_year, y = count, color = crime_type, linetype = crime_type)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Total Crimes by Type Over Time",
       x = "Year",
       y = "Count",
       color = "Crime Type",
       linetype = "Crime Type") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Human" = "blue", 
                                "Hate" = "red", 
                                "Cargo" = "green", 
                                "Assault" = "purple")) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```

```{r create}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

crimes_per_yr_human_st <- human_traffic_filtered %>%
  group_by(DATA_YEAR, STATE_ABBR) %>%
  summarize(total_crimes_human_st = sum(ACTUAL_COUNT, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')

print(crimes_per_yr_human_st)

crimes_per_yr_hate_st <- hate_crimes_filtered %>%
  group_by(DATA_YEAR, STATE_ABBR) %>%
  summarize(total_crimes_hate = sum(incident_id, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')

print(crimes_per_yr_hate_st)

crimes_per_yr_cargo_st <- cargo_filtered %>%
  group_by(DATA_YEAR, STATE_ABBR) %>%
  summarize(total_crimes_cargo = n(), .groups = 'drop')

print(crimes_per_yr_cargo_st)


crimes_per_yr_assault_st <- assault_filtered %>%
  group_by(DATA_YEAR, STATE_ABBR) %>%
  summarize(total_crimes_assault = n(), .groups = 'drop')

print(crimes_per_yr_assault_st)


```

```{r plot2}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

region <- c("Midwest", "Northeast", "South", "West", "U.S. Territories", "Other")

crime_types <- c("Human", "Hate", "Cargo", "Assault")

years <- 2018:2022

total_rows <- length(years) * length(region) * length(crime_types)

crimes <- data.frame(
  year = rep(years, each = length(region) * length(crime_types)),
  region = rep(region, times = length(crime_types) * length(2018:2022)),
  crime_type = rep(crime_types, each = length(region), times = length(2018:2022)),
  crime_count = sample(50:150, length(2018:2022) * length(region) * length(crime_types), replace = TRUE)
)

head(crimes)

# Summarize total crimes per year, state, and crime type
summary_data <- crimes %>%
  group_by(year, region, crime_type) %>%
  summarize(total_crimes = sum(crime_count), .groups = 'drop')

head(summary_data)

ggplot(summary_data, aes(x = year, y = total_crimes, color = crime_type, linetype = crime_type)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Total Crimes by Type, Year, and Region",
       x = "Year",
       y = "Total Crimes",
       color = "Crime Type",
       linetype = "Crime Type") +
  facet_wrap(~ region, scales = "free_y") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 12),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Human" = "blue", 
                                "Hate" = "red", 
                                "Cargo" = "green", 
                                "Assault" = "purple")) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
